name: subscription-agents
description: GitHub Copilot, Grok and Codex as sub-agents, on the subscriptions their own CLIs are logged in to

auth.hint: Sign in with the Copilot CLI (see its docs), or start the harness with COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN set to a fine-grained token that has the "Copilot Requests" permission.
Sign in with the Grok CLI (see its docs). XAI_API_KEY also works but is billed per token, not on the subscription.
Log in with the Codex CLI (codex login, or codex login --device-auth on a headless machine); with OCTO_CODEX_HOME set, log in with CODEX_HOME pointing at the same folder.
